Bleed.title: Bleed
Bleed.name: Bleed
Bleed.description: 每层：在[color=#ffff50]移动[/color] / [color=#ff8030]攻击[/color]时受到 5 [color=#ff1010]鲜血[/color]伤害

Agony.title: Agony
Agony.name: Agony
Agony.description: 在[color=#ffff50]受到伤害[/color]时：在其他加成后，将其提高到最大生命的[color=#ff5050]2%[/color]

Scorch.title: Scorch
Scorch.name: Scorch
Scorch.description: 每层：在[color=#ffff50]游戏回合[/color]时受到 10 [color=#ff7000]火焰[/color]伤害[color=#707070]每 20 层重复一次[/color]

Poison.title: Poison
Poison.name: Poison
Poison.description: 你中毒了。每回合受到等同于最大生命 10% 的毒素伤害。

Sickness.title: Sickness
Sickness.name: Sickness
Sickness.description: 每层：[color=#ff3030]-10[/color] [color=#ff8030]命中[/color]，在[color=#ffff50]游戏回合[/color]时受到 5 [color=#70ff00]毒素[/color]伤害

Plague.title: Plague
Plague.name: Plague
Plague.description: 每层：[color=#ff3030]-1%[/color] [color=#ffff50]所有抗性[/color][color=#a0a0a0]最多降至 0%[/color]；在[color=#ffff50]游戏回合[/color]时受到 10 [color=#70ff00]毒素[/color] / [color=#a0a000]死亡[/color]伤害，并将层数传播给相邻盟友

Freeze.title: Freeze
Freeze.name: Freeze
Freeze.description: 每层：[color=#ff3030]-10 [/color][color=#50ffff]闪避[/color]，[color=#ff3030]-1 [/color][color=#20ff20]速度[/color]；在[color=#ffff50]站立不动[/color]时受到 5 [color=#5080ff]寒冰[/color]伤害；在[color=#ffff50]被攻击[/color]时受到 1 [color=#af8f50]钝击[/color]伤害

Paralysis.title: Paralysis
Paralysis.name: Paralysis
Paralysis.description: [color=#20ff20]速度[/color]限制为[color=#ff3030]最低值[/color]，[color=#50ffff]闪避[/color]设为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]

JinBu.title: Jin-bu
JinBu.name: Jin-bu
JinBu.description: 命中骰与速度骰各获得 2 个额外骰

Poise.title: Poise
Poise.name: Poise
Poise.description:
每层：[color=#5050ff]+5 护甲[/color]，[color=#5050ff]+5 格挡[/color]，[color=#ffa050]+10 精准[/color]

在[color=#ffff50]移动[/color]时[color=#ff5050]移除 25%[/color]

Repulsion.title: Repulsion
Repulsion.name: Repulsion
Repulsion.description: 每层：在[color=#ffff50]被攻击[/color]时对攻击者造成 1 [color=#ffaf30]灵能[/color]伤害

Refraction.title: Refraction
Refraction.name: Refraction
Refraction.description: 每层：[color=#5050ff]+1 护甲[/color]；在[color=#ffff50]被攻击[/color]时对攻击者造成 10 [color=#70ff00]毒素[/color]伤害

Grace.title: Grace
Grace.name: Grace
Grace.description: 每层：受到的伤害[color=#ffff50]-5[/color]；在[color=#ffff50]被攻击[/color]时对攻击者造成 5 [color=#8030af]星界[/color]伤害

Inflame.title: Inflame
Inflame.name: Inflame
Inflame.description:
每层：[color=#ffa050]+10 精准[/color]，[color=#ff8030]+20 命中[/color]

在[color=#ffff50]被命中[/color]时[color=#ff5050]移除 50%[/color]

Attune.title: Attune
Attune.name: Attune
Attune.description: 每层：[color=#ff8030]+10 命中[/color]，[color=#5050ff]+20 护甲[/color]，[color=#ffff50]+1%[/color] 造成伤害

Meditate.title: Meditate
Meditate.name: Meditate
Meditate.description:
每层：[color=#ffff50]+10[/color] 造成伤害

在[color=#ffff50]移动[/color]时[color=#ff5050]移除 50%[/color]

Entangle.title: Entangle
Entangle.name: Entangle
Entangle.description: 每层：[color=#ff3030]-10 [/color][color=#50ffff]闪避[/color]，[color=#ff3030]-1 [/color][color=#20ff20]速度[/color]；在[color=#ffff50]移动[/color]时受到 5 [color=#af8f50]穿刺[/color]伤害

Dream.title: Dream
Dream.name: Dream
Dream.description:
每层：[color=#ff3030]-10 [/color][color=#50ffff]闪避[/color]，[color=#ff3030]-2 [/color][color=#20ff20]速度[/color]；在[color=#ffff50]游戏回合[/color] / [color=#ffff50]站立不动[/color]时，对最近的敌人造成 10 [color=#5080ff]寒冰[/color] / [color=#ffaf30]灵能[/color]伤害

在[color=#ffff50]移动[/color]或[color=#ff8030]攻击[/color]时[color=#ff5050]移除[/color]

Windstrike.title: Windstrike
Windstrike.name: Windstrike
Windstrike.description:
[color=#50ffff]+300 闪避[/color]，[color=#20ff20]+100 速度[/color]

每层[color=#80ff80]重复[/color]：在[color=#ff8030]攻击[/color]时，对目标造成等同于主手命中的[color=#af8f50]斩击[/color]伤害；然后[color=#ff5050]移除[/color]

Mark.title: Mark
Mark.name: Mark
Mark.description:
每层：受到的所有[color=#af8f50]物理[/color]伤害提高[color=#ffff50]10%[/color]

[color=#a0a0a0]“物理”伤害包括斩击、钝击和穿刺[/color]

Berserk.title: Berserk
Berserk.name: Berserk
Berserk.description:
在[color=#707070]初始攻击[/color]时获得一次[color=#ff8030]额外攻击[/color]

每层：[color=#20ff20]+1 速度[/color]，[color=#ff3030]-10 [/color][color=#50ffff]闪避[/color]，[color=#ff3030]-10 [/color][color=#5050ff]格挡[/color]

Evasion.title: Evasion
Evasion.name: Evasion
Evasion.description:
每层：[color=#50ffff]+20 闪避[/color]

在[color=#ffff50]站立不动[/color]时[color=#ff5050]移除 50%[/color]

Charge.title: Charge
Charge.name: Charge
Charge.description:
每层：[color=#ffff50]+5[/color] 造成伤害

在[color=#ffff50]站立不动[/color]时[color=#ff5050]移除 50%[/color]

Stasis.title: Stasis
Stasis.name: Stasis
Stasis.description:
[color=#ff5050]阻止[/color]传送

在[color=#ffff50]被攻击[/color]时[color=#ff5050]移除 1 层[/color]

Anoint.title: Anoint
Anoint.name: Anoint
Anoint.description: 每层：[color=#ff8030]+20 命中[/color]，[color=#50ffff]+10 闪避[/color]

Gust.title: Gust
Gust.name: Gust
Gust.description: 每层[color=#80ff80]重复[/color]：在[color=#ff8030]攻击[/color]时，沿路径对任意距离的 1 个敌人造成 50 + 敏捷 的[color=#af8f50]斩击[/color]伤害；然后[color=#ff5050]移除[/color]

Protection.title: Protection
Protection.name: Protection
Protection.description:
在[color=#ffff50]受到其他单位造成的伤害[/color]时：将其限制为[color=#ffff50]1[/color]；在[color=#ffff50]被攻击[/color] / [color=#ffff50]受到伤害[/color]时有[color=#ff5050]20% 概率移除[/color]

该效果[color=#ff5050]永远不能超过 1 层[/color]

Corrosion.title: Corrosion
Corrosion.name: Corrosion
Corrosion.description: 每层：[color=#ff3030]-20 [/color][color=#5050ff]格挡[/color]，[color=#ff3030]-10 [/color][color=#5050ff]护甲[/color]；在[color=#ffff50]被攻击[/color]时受到 1 [color=#ff7000]火焰[/color]伤害

Doom.title: Doom
Doom.name: Doom
Doom.description: 每层：在[color=#ffff50]被攻击[/color]时受到 5 [color=#a0a000]死亡[/color]伤害

Batform.title: Batform
Batform.name: Batform
Batform.description:
变身：[color=#ffff50]攻击范围[/color]设为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]，[color=#5050ff]护甲[/color] / [color=#5050ff]格挡[/color]设为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]

每层：[color=#20ff20]+1 速度[/color]，在[color=#ff8030]命中[/color]时[color=#50ff50]治疗[/color] 5

Snakeform.title: Snakeform
Snakeform.name: Snakeform
Snakeform.description:
变身：[color=#ffff50]攻击范围[/color]设为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]

每层：[color=#50ffff]+10 闪避[/color]，在[color=#78bca4]神圣干预[/color]时[color=#50ff50]治疗[/color] 10

Wormform.title: Wormform
Wormform.name: Wormform
Wormform.description:
变身：[color=#ffff50]攻击范围[/color]设为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]

每层：在[color=#ff8030]攻击[/color]时，对 3 格范围内所有敌人施加 2 层[color=#ff7000]灼烧[/color]

Flameform.title: Flameform
Flameform.name: Flameform
Flameform.description:
变身：[color=#ffff50]攻击范围[/color]设为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]

每层：在[color=#ff8030]攻击[/color]时，对 3 格范围内所有敌人施加 2 层[color=#ff7000]灼烧[/color]

Sparkform.title: Sparkform
Sparkform.name: Sparkform
Sparkform.description:
变身：[color=#20ff20]+30 速度[/color]，[color=#ffff50]攻击范围[/color]设为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]，[color=#5050ff]格挡[/color] / [color=#5050ff]护甲[/color]设为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]

每层：在[color=#ff8030]攻击[/color]时，对 2 格范围内所有单位造成 10 [color=#0060ff]闪电[/color]伤害

Drakeform.title: Drakeform
Drakeform.name: Drakeform
Drakeform.description:
变身：[color=#ffff50]攻击范围[/color]设为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]；在[color=#ff8030]攻击[/color]时，对相邻敌人进行一次 50 伤害的[color=#ff8030]命中[/color]

每层：[color=#5050ff]+10 护甲[/color]，[color=#5050ff]+20 格挡[/color]；在[color=#ff8030]攻击[/color]时，对 2 格范围内所有单位造成 25 [color=#ff7000]火焰[/color]伤害

Lizardform.title: Lizardform
Lizardform.name: Lizardform
Lizardform.description:
变身：[color=#20ff20]速度[/color]限制为[color=#ff3030]15[/color]，[color=#ffff50]攻击范围[/color]设为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]；在[color=#ffff50]被攻击[/color]时，对攻击者造成等同于你[color=#5050ff]护甲[/color]的[color=#70ff00]毒素[/color]伤害

每层：在[color=#ff8030]攻击[/color]时[color=#50ff50]治疗[/color] 10，并对目标施加 5 层[color=#70ff00]疾病[/color] / [color=#ffd000]腐蚀[/color] / [color=#ff7000]灼烧[/color]

Horrorform.title: Horrorform
Horrorform.name: Horrorform
Horrorform.description:
变身：[color=#20ff20]+50 速度[/color]，[color=#5050ff]护甲[/color] / [color=#5050ff]格挡[/color]设为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]

每层：在[color=#ff8030]攻击[/color]时，对敌人施加 10 层[color=#ff1010]流血[/color]并造成 1 [color=#8030af]星界[/color]伤害

Treeform.title: Treeform
Treeform.name: Treeform
Treeform.description:
变身：[color=#20ff20]速度[/color]限制为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]，除[color=#ff7000]火焰[/color]外[color=#ffff50]+75% 所有抗性[/color]

在[color=#ffff50]移动[/color]或[color=#ff8030]攻击[/color]时[color=#ff5050]移除[/color]

Vineform.title: Vineform
Vineform.name: Vineform
Vineform.description:
变身：[color=#ff3030]-50%[/color] [color=#ff7000]火焰抗性[/color]；在[color=#ff8030]攻击[/color]时召唤一个[color=#20af50]根须[/color]；在[color=#ffff50]移动[/color]时对相邻敌人进行一次[color=#ff8030]额外攻击[/color]

每层：在[color=#ff8030]攻击[/color]时，为所有盟友[color=#50ff50]治疗[/color] 5，并给予友方[color=#00a000]植物[/color][color=#ff8030]+10 命中[/color]

Geistform.title: Geistform
Geistform.name: Geistform
Geistform.description:
变身：[color=#20ff20]速度[/color]限制为[color=#ff3030]10[/color]，[color=#ff8030]命中[/color]设为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]；若仍有敌人存活，在[color=#ffff50]站立不动[/color]时执行你所有“[color=#ffff50]游戏回合[/color]”动作[color=#707070]不会推进效果倒计时[/color]

每层：若仍有敌人存活，在[color=#ffff50]游戏回合[/color]时[color=#50ff50]治疗[/color] 1，并对所有敌人施加 1 层[color=#5080ff]冻结[/color]

Beastform.title: Beastform
Beastform.name: Beastform
Beastform.description:
变身：[color=#ffff50]攻击范围[/color]设为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]；执行非[color=#ff8030]攻击[/color]行动时[color=#ff3030]-1[/color]层[color=#707070]站立不动 / 移动 / 祈祷[/color]

每层：在[color=#ffff50]被攻击[/color]时，对相邻敌人进行一次[color=#ff8030]额外攻击[/color]

Crowform.title: Crowform
Crowform.name: Crowform
Crowform.description:
变身：[color=#5050ff]格挡[/color] / [color=#5050ff]护甲[/color]设为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]

每层：[color=#ffff50]+1%[/color] 造成伤害

Wildform.title: Wildform
Wildform.name: Wildform
Wildform.description:
变身：[color=#ffff50]攻击范围[/color]设为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]

每层：在[color=#ff8030]攻击[/color]时，沿路径对 3 格范围内 1 个敌人造成 10 [color=#70ff00]毒素[/color]伤害，并以[color=#ff7000]火焰[/color] / [color=#0060ff]闪电[/color]伤害重复

Anqarak.title: Anqarak
Anqarak.name: Anqarak
Anqarak.description:
变身：在[color=#707070]初始攻击[/color]时获得 2 次[color=#ff8030]额外攻击[/color]，[color=#ffff50]攻击范围[/color]设为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]，[color=#5050ff]格挡[/color]设为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]

每层：在[color=#ff8030]攻击[/color] / [color=#ffff50]被攻击[/color]时，对敌人造成 2 [color=#ff1010]鲜血[/color]伤害

Newtform.title: Newtform
Newtform.name: Newtform
Newtform.description:
变身：[color=#ffff50]攻击范围[/color]设为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]

每层：在[color=#ff8030]攻击[/color] / [color=#ffff50]被攻击[/color]时，对 3 格范围内所有敌人施加 2 层[color=#ffd000]腐蚀[/color]

[color=#ffd000]腐蚀[/color]每层：[color=#ff3030]-20 [/color][color=#5050ff]格挡[/color]，[color=#ff3030]-10 [/color][color=#5050ff]护甲[/color]；在[color=#ffff50]被攻击[/color]时受到 1 [color=#ff7000]火焰[/color]伤害

Jackalform.title: Jackalform
Jackalform.name: Jackalform
Jackalform.description:
变身：[color=#ffff50]攻击范围[/color]设为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]，[color=#5050ff]护甲[/color]设为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]

每层：[color=#20ff20]+1 速度[/color]，[color=#ff8030]+10 命中[/color]，在[color=#ffff50]击杀[/color]时[color=#50ff50]治疗[/color] 5

Crystalform.title: Crystalform
Crystalform.name: Crystalform
Crystalform.description:
变身：[color=#ff8030]命中[/color]设为[color=#ff3030]1[/color]，[color=#ff0000]僵硬度翻倍[/color]；若仍有敌人存活，在[color=#ffff50]站立不动[/color]时执行你所有“[color=#ffff50]游戏回合[/color]”动作[color=#707070]不会推进效果倒计时[/color]

每层：若仍有敌人存活，在[color=#ffff50]游戏回合[/color]时[color=#50ff50]治疗[/color] 1，并对所有敌人施加 1 层[color=#5080ff]冻结[/color]
